thesis: The page is an Alaskan car-year magazine issue: each scroll section turns the page to the next season, and a live outside-temperature readout in the margin ticks forward as you read.

signature.name: Car-Year Thermometer Rail
signature.summary: A thin vertical rail on the left margin carries a mercury-bulb thermometer glyph and a mono temperature readout that updates via --sw-p as each season section enters view; repeated inline on mobile headers.

palette.family: Glacier Blue + Fireweed Magenta + Spruce Green + Snow Paper

motion.intro: Cover lines slide in sequentially; temperature ticks from -20F to current over 1.1s.
stories: Temperature readout crossfades per season; lead color band shifts hue; photo unclips vertically.
motion.hover: Hairline underline grows left-to-right under season links, 200ms.
